title: Compare two representations of the same request
question: Does the same request route differently with word features or sentence features?
summary: The same message enters two independent pipelines. Each classifier is fitted separately; compare predictions on matching validation requests.

steps.title: Same request: official-train/00021
steps.body: “What is the status of my card’s delivery?” is a bundled review example labeled card_arrival.
steps.input: What is the status of my card’s delivery?

steps.title: TF–IDF + classifier
steps.body: Fit a vocabulary and word weights on training text. Fit the classifier on those sparse vectors. Creating the estimator alone does not train it.
steps.code:
model = make_pipeline(
  TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1, 2),
                  sublinear_tf=True), head)
model.fit(texts, labels)
steps.excerpt_label: Abbreviated code; full function in notebook.

steps.title: Frozen MiniLM + classifier
steps.body: Encode the same message into 384 values. The encoder stays frozen; fit a separate classifier on the training vectors. TF–IDF is not an input to this path.
steps.excerpt_label: Abbreviated code; full function in notebook.

steps.title: Compare matching validation requests
steps.body: Both pipelines use the same training assignment and validation request IDs. Compare their predicted intents and remaining mistakes; neither representation feeds the other.
steps.code:
a = predict(
    word_model, data, "validation")
b = predict(
    sentence_model, data, "validation")
steps.output: Same case IDs; two predicted intents
steps.excerpt_label: Abbreviated code; full function in notebook.
